title: commelina edulis
intro: Commelina edulis, commonly known as dayflower or small blue dayflower, is a perennial plant species native to Australia, New Zealand, and parts of Asia. The health benefits of Commelina edulis include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and aid in weight management due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, which are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Commelina edulis include flavonoids such as kaempferol and quercetin, as well as alkaloids like commelinin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
